PanelTooltip: Tato funkce umožňuje automaticky řídit zapínání a vypínání hořáku podle uživatelem nastavených hodnot.
ActivationThreshold: Aktivační práh: hořák se aktivuje, když úroveň naplnění zásobníku překročí maximum.
PauseThreshold: Pozastaví se, když úroveň naplnění zásobníku klesne pod minimum.
NoStoragesFound: V okruhu 100 polí nebyly nalezeny naplněné zásobníky kapalin.
ChooseTankHint: Choose a liquid storage from the list.
TankNotConnectedHint: Tank is not connected to the pipe network.
BufferDescription: Stores 200 units of one gas or steam grade: exhaust, oxygen, nitrogen, carbon dioxide or any of the four steam grades. No conversion or cooling. Exhaust and steam are transported only through pipes.
PlantTooltip: With a storage selected, only its waste type is burned. Water and required fuel gases remain allowed. Other recipes stay assigned. An already-started batch can finish. Without a storage selection, normal operation applies.
BurnerTooltip: With a storage selected, only its product can start burning. Other assigned recipes are blocked, not removed. An already-started batch can finish. Without a storage selection, normal operation applies.
DisposalTooltip: Automatic control based on the selected storage fill level. Its product must match an assigned recipe.
DisposalActivation: Activation: The building starts when the storage fill level reaches the maximum.
DisposalPause: Pause: The building pauses when the storage fill level reaches the minimum.
NoProductRestriction: No storage selected: no product restriction.
ChooseRecipeStorage: Choose a storage for the assigned recipe.
NoDisposalStorages: No matching storages within 100 tiles. Assign the matching product to a storage first.
DisposalConnectionHint: Storage is available for automatic control.
